target: Future DO mean of supported minute medians, mg/L
limitations: No partitions or final supervised indices are frozen.
Hourly summaries retain unresolved measurement-review flags; calibration accuracy is unverified.
Pond recordings are context diagnostics, not part of the primary fitting release or an independent-site holdout.
Overlapping windows are dependent and pre-split counts overstate final usable examples.
Shrimp, other species, low-DO event detection and disease prediction are unsupported.
Partition and calibration-period sufficiency may require further narrowing; interval reliability is not established.
